title: Check and parse a number
summary: NestJS: Check and parse a number. Visit /double/cat.
introduction: ParseIntPipe reads an integer or rejects bad input. GET /double/4 uses the checked number.
learningObjectives: Check and parse a number with NestJS

blocks.text: Create a practice project with npx @nestjs/cli new school. Replace src/main.ts with one complete example and run npm run start. Use http://127.0.0.1:3000. The original app files are unused by these small examples.

blocks.title: Check and parse a number

blocks.text: ParseIntPipe converts 4 before the method runs. Multiplying the resulting number gives 8.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: The pipe does the runtime check; the number annotation alone does not.
